changes: 🪙 Double or Nothing: coin is bigger (130px, was 78px) and the tumble is genuinely slower (1.5s, was 0.75s). The portrait/logo now feather into the coin's own gold background with a warm colour grade instead of looking like a cutout pasted on top.

🚀 Crash: found and fixed the real cause of the stutter — a CSS animation was silently overriding any rotation set from JS, and a position transition was fighting with the frequent updates. Rewrote the whole animation loop on requestAnimationFrame (smooth, browser-synced) and the rocket now genuinely points the direction it's travelling, recalculated every frame instead of a fixed angle.
